controls.name: stale_source_manifest
controls.purpose: Reject a candidate manifest whose recorded source hash no longer matches the immutable candidate bytes before caller execution.
controls.minimal_adaptation: Keep the private poisoned-manifest assertion; report it as manifest validation, not a caller/D68 refusal.

controls.name: source_gate_root_mismatch
controls.purpose: Reject a source tuple and frozen gate tuple that name different repository roots.
controls.intended_phase: caller require_root_binding after source_identity and gate_identity
controls.static_result: reaches the intended caller binding phase when service TMP is valid; prior logged refusal is not evidence for any later D68 branch
controls.minimal_adaptation: Use a fresh valid private service root and assert the binding error/path; retain no-receipt and no-builder assertions.

controls.name: stale_nonapp_upstream
controls.purpose: Reject a non-App gate whose recorded upstream_base is stale relative to the fixture's current origin/main.
controls.static_result: not reached in the original run because the retained trace collided; after isolation the fixture accepts because origin/main remains stale_base, then writes PASS. The control is false-positive, not semantic PASS.
controls.minimal_adaptation: After creating stale_head, advance the fixture refs/heads/origin/main to stale_head while keeping recorded upstream_base=stale_base; then adapt the checker to observe the caller's nonzero return and FAIL diagnostic receipt.

controls.name: wrong_source_owner
controls.purpose: Reject a source repository whose owner is not the effective user.
controls.static_result: intended source-owner phase; no D68 execution should be claimed
controls.minimal_adaptation: Keep the source-owner perturbation isolated to the caller's source-directory check; do not treat the pre-D68 refusal as a D68 semantic result.

controls.name: wrong_source_mode
controls.purpose: Reject a source repository writable by group/other before source use.
controls.static_result: intended source-mode phase; no D68 execution should be claimed
controls.minimal_adaptation: Keep the 0775 source fixture and assert the source-directory mode error; preserve source immutability checks.

controls.name: wrong_stage_owner
controls.purpose: Reject the D68 private stage parent when its owner is not the effective user.
controls.static_result: false-positive coverage: monkeypatching caller.os.geteuid mutates the shared os module, so caller source_identity fails first; the stage branch is untested
controls.minimal_adaptation: Keep service_tmp valid and perturb only the stage-parent ownership after caller validation, using a private harness seam or stage-parent fixture; do not globally patch os.geteuid before source checks.

controls.name: wrong_stage_mode
controls.purpose: Reject the D68 private stage parent unless it is exactly mode 0700.
controls.static_result: false-positive coverage: the 0775 directory is supplied as service_tmp and caller.run_wrapper rejects it at line 212 before D68 creates/checks its stage parent
controls.minimal_adaptation: Use a valid 0700 outer service_tmp, then make only the D68 --stage-parent fixture 0775 through a private harness entrypoint; preserve the real caller -> D68 route.

additional_controls.wrong_app_base_and_tree: Caller/D68 tuple validation controls; do not call them source-guard semantic passes.
additional_controls.dirty_symlink_ref_drift: Caller source/gate identity controls; phase-specific refusal only.
additional_controls.lifecycle_floor_trace_controls: Same33 lifecycle controls; a floor/trace refusal is safety coverage, never evidence that a later source guard fired.
